snapshot_source: Saved inventory captured 2026-09-08. Proposal only; refresh exact guards before any apply.
scope: Paired RAM and storage estimates for 40 uncovered published, self-hostable apps. Each estimate uses an app-specific small setup and official project or install sources. Sink is included because its official guide supports deploying a fork to the user’s Cloudflare Worker account with user-created D1 and KV bindings; its RAM range is per-isolate, not a host requirement.
